source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
    [HRRecordID]
    ,[EmployeeID]
    ,[HomeID]
    ,[HRChecklistID]
    ,[ItemGroupID]
    ,[ItemName]
    ,[ItemStatus]
    ,[ItemValue1]
    ,[ItemValue2]
    ,[ItemReference]
    ,[ItemNotes]
    ,DATEADD(s, ReviewDueDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS [ReviewDueDate]
    ,DATEADD(SECOND, ItemExpires / 1000000.0, CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS datetime2)) AS [ItemExpires]
    ,DATEADD(ss, RequestedDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS [RequestedDate]
    ,DATEADD(ss, ReceivedDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS [ReceivedDate]
    ,DATEADD(ss, CreatedDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS [CreatedDate]
    ,[CreatedByID]
    ,DATEADD(ss, [ClosedDate], '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS [ClosedDate]
    ,[ClosedByID]
    ,DATEADD(ss, LastUpdatedDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS [LastUpdatedDate]
    ,[LastUpdatedByID]
    ,[Deleted]
FROM 
    CareBlox.stgtblHR_Records

activities.name: Removed edited Paylines
activities.description: Deletes the payline records that are not present in the newly staged data. Limit delete records to the shifts we just staged, and delete those paylines that aren't present in the new paylines staged data

scripts.text:
DELETE
FROM Sona.PayLines
WHERE 

EXISTS --Limit to the shifts we have exported data for (weekly data)
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM Sona.STG_Shifts AS ss
    WHERE ss.shift_id = PayLines.shift_id
)
AND NOT EXISTS --Exclude paylines that match paylines and shifts just exported and staged
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM Sona.STG_PayLines AS sp
    WHERE sp.shift_id = PayLines.shift_id
      AND sp.PayLines_id = PayLines.PayLine_id
)
